added.summary: Ten more HUD components as TSX, beside their .svelte: ActionHints, Cooldown, HudEffect, BossBar, Killfeed, HudLootEntry, OrbMeter, OverlayBar, PickupFeed and ProgressBar. Styles are Tailwind classes; SVG waves, weapon silhouettes and glare arcs are dropped (the orb's liquid is a flat fill, the killfeed's weapons show in words), the boss bar's phase thresholds stand as diamonds, and the overlays bar's horizontal scroll has no surface yet.
